legal_consequences.refill: Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-validity rules apply; do not substitute the federal CIII-IV refill rule.
legal_consequences.transfer: Apply the current Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-transfer rules.
legal_consequences.partial_fill: Schedule II partial-fill remainder rules do not apply merely because gabapentin is MassPAT-reportable.
legal_consequences.masspat: Gabapentin is a DPH-designated additional drug and covered dispensing transactions are MassPAT-reportable.
legal_consequences.quantity_limit: The Massachusetts Schedule II and III quantity policy does not directly govern gabapentin.

verification_notes: DailyMed confirms indications and no federal DEA schedule; Massachusetts regulation and the current official dispenser guide confirm Schedule VI and MassPAT treatment.
